column1: # WARN = report but do not fail
# Application Error Disclosure — acceptable in dev/DAST context
# Cookie without Secure flag — acceptable since DAST runs over HTTP locally
# Cookie without SameSite — flask default, not a blocker
# Missing HTTPS — DAST runs over HTTP locally, HTTPS enforced at ALB
# CSP missing — addressed at ALB/WAF level
